svg.title: The Dream and the Stone
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Daniel 2:1-3): Nebuchadnezzar lying awake on his couch at night. Caption: "Babylon, 603 BC. The king cannot sleep." Nebuchadnezzar says: "I had a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream." Panel 2 (Daniel 2:27-28): Daniel standing before Nebuchadnezzar, pointing upward. Caption: "Daniel before the king." Daniel says: "There is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries." Panel 3 (Daniel 2:31-38): the great image standing in the dream: head of gold, chest and arms of silver, middle of bronze, legs of iron, feet of iron and clay. Caption: "Gold, silver, bronze, iron, iron mixed with clay." Daniel says: "You are the head of gold." Panel 4 (Daniel 2:34-35): the image struck: a stone flying at its feet; fragments of gold, silver, bronze, iron and clay blowing away on the wind. Caption: "A stone cut out by no human hand strikes the feet." Note: "Broken “all together” and blown away like chaff." Panel 5 (Daniel 2:35, 46-47): a great grey mountain filling the horizon; Nebuchadnezzar on his knees before Daniel. Caption: "The stone becomes a great mountain and fills the whole earth." Nebuchadnezzar says: "Truly, your God is God of gods and Lord of kings." The point: Every kingdom you live under will pass, and God will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed, His Son's (Daniel 2:44; 7:13-14).
svg.text: Daniel 2: the kingdoms of men, and the kingdom of God
